Scholarship overview

OIST recruits international applicants for its PhD programme in Okinawa. Researchers undertake rotations before choosing a research group, giving them a route into experimental or computational work across the institute's research units.

Research Areas

  • Interdisciplinary science
  • Experimental research
  • Computational research

About Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology (OIST)

OIST is a graduate research institute in Okinawa, Japan. Its PhD programme uses research rotations before students choose a research group and provides financial support to admitted doctoral students.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.oist.jp/admissions/phd-program/apply-phd

Source: oist.jp - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 15 November 2026, 23:59 JST - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 15 November 2026, 23:59 JST. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
